headline: 17 of 17 items checked. 16 still reproduce outright. 1 (T2-06) is confirmed at the database level but its live-UI half could not be exercised from a read-only session. Nothing was already fixed.

items.oneLineFinding: Still 503 live, and the cause is a code defect rather than only a missing setting: api/payment-links.mjs:110-116 refuses the request whenever COMMAS_CHECKOUT_BASE_URL is unset, even though the function it guards prefers a different route that mints a checkout session from the API key that IS set — so the endpoint is stricter than the code behind it.
items.corroboration: A parallel live-probe agent writing into this same folder captured the live 503 at 2026-08-19T02:46:57Z with the exact message 'COMMAS_CHECKOUT_BASE_URL is not set — no checkout link can be built' (live-before-payment-links.json). That file was not collected by this agent; it is cited, not vouched for.

items.oneLineFinding: The Client Control Panel still has no way to create a pay link — a case-insensitive grep for 'payment-link', 'pay link', 'paymentLink' and 'create.*pay' across public/app/client-control-panel.html returns zero matches, so there is not even a disabled button.

The unlock half is confirmed dead — product_entitlements is empty, entitlements holds nothing for the test client and v_client_entitlements returns no rows for them — but whether pressing Sign still writes a consent row and still unlocks nothing has to be re-walked in the live portal.
All 5 entitlement_catalog rows still have display_price_cents NULL, and migration 171 that added the column is confirmed applied — so this is an unfilled column, not a missing one.
product_entitlements still holds exactly 0 rows, so no purchase of any product can unlock any tile.

Title matching runs off product_aliases, and none of the current checkout titles ('UnderwriteIQ soft-pull assessment', 'Credit repair, done-for-you', 'Repair test run…') has an alias row — only the legacy 'Business Financial Assessment' does, which is exactly why it is the only title that ever produced a diagnostic.paid.
entitlement_catalog still has 5 codes while public/app/client-portal.html's MAP still has 6 tile keys, so one tile has no product behind it.

The credit-repair sale ee7b9598 is still filed against product code consulting-package instead of repair-bundle, and repair-bundle does exist as a product, so the wrong row is being chosen rather than a missing one.

There is still no $200 product — the 5 product codes are diagnostic, card-stacking-dfy, consulting-package, repair-bundle ($2,000) and inquiry-removal — even though a payment_links row for 'Repair test run' at 20000 cents already exists.
REPAIR_DFY and REPAIR_TRIAL still both map to 'metro2-letter-pack' at public/app/client-portal.html lines 1329 and 1330, so a $200 trial would open the $1,000 deliverable.
FUNDING_MASTERY still maps to null at public/app/client-portal.html line 1332, so the $5,000 tile has no rule that can ever turn it on.

src/register-all.mjs still subscribes nothing to contract.signed — the word 'contract' does not appear in the file at all — while src/contracts/sign.mjs:515 emits the event and 5 contract.signed rows sit in the events table with nothing having acted on them.

Every one of the 9 real (source='commas') payment events still has client_id NULL — the rows that appear to have a client are all the previous audit's own w16-sim simulations — but the payloads do carry an email and often a ref that resolves through payment_links.link_ref, and all 40 payment_links rows have a non-null client_id, so a real resolution path exists.

Draft 8988b582 is still an unvoided draft, and the cause is the check constraint contracts_sent_has_artifact_ck: voiding flips status off 'draft', which then demands body_sha, sent_at and rendered_body be present — all three are NULL on a never-sent draft, so the UPDATE fails and surfaces as 500 write_failed.

Paid events still unlock nothing — the simulated payments wrote 3 sales rows for the test client, yet product_entitlements stayed empty and the client holds no entitlements in either the entitlements table or the v_client_entitlements view.
There is still no crs_paid column on clients — zero columns match '%crs%' — and the flag lives only inside the custom_fields jsonb blob, where it is set for just 2 clients.

Signed copies are still never delivered — all 4 not_delivered documents are '(signed)' copies, and the pattern repeats exactly per contract: the original goes out with delivery_status 'sent' while the countersigned copy is created as 'not_delivered' and never picked up again.

Confirmed, with a nuance worth carrying: repair-bundle exists at default_price 2000.00, which is $2,000 and NOT the $200 REPAIR_TRIAL. Anyone skim-reading '2000' as the trial price will map the wrong product.

questions.question: Which entitlement should the $200 REPAIR_TRIAL unlock? It currently shares 'metro2-letter-pack' with the $1,000 REPAIR_DFY. No doc, migration, code comment or catalog row records a distinct entitlement for the trial, and entitlement_catalog has no spare code for it. Inventing one would be inventing product policy.

questions.question: What price should each of the 5 entitlement_catalog rows display? The column is applied and empty; no doc records the intended per-entitlement display prices. src/config/offers.mjs prices are per-OFFER, not per-entitlement, and the two do not map one-to-one.

Should a closer be allowed to create a pay link? The 403 is deliberate — ROLE_SETS.FINANCE is {owner, admin, sales_manager} and closer is excluded, while closer IS in ROLE_SETS.STAFF. The audit calls this broken, but widening a role set on a regulated money path is a policy call, not a bug fix.

crossLinks.insight: These two are the same defect seen from both ends. src/payment-links/index.mjs has two ways to build a checkout: the preferred one mints a Commas session and passes metadata {link_ref, client_id, org_id}, and the fallback just builds a URL from COMMAS_CHECKOUT_BASE_URL and passes no metadata at all. All 40 existing links were made by the fallback, which is precisely why their payment events come back carrying only a bare ref and no client id. Fixing T2-04 by making the mint path reachable would also give the webhook a client_id to read, which is the cleanest available fix for T2-18. Fixing T2-04 by merely setting COMMAS_CHECKOUT_BASE_URL would restore payments while leaving every future payment event orphaned.
